name: Silence Sentinel Guard
description: before_agent_finalize: a reply that is a silence sentinel carrying anything else — a 🎩, or the token alone under other output — is sent back for one more pass. The gateway matches NO_REPLY and HEARTBEAT_OK exactly, so anything attached breaks the match and the whole reply, logs included, is delivered to the user. Built 2026-10-09 after he received a wall of the email daemon's [Cal] log lines ending 'NO_REPLY 🎩'.
